title: Stripe Financial Metrics and Payment Volume 2023-2024
content:
Stripe demonstrated remarkable financial growth and scale throughout 2023. The fintech giant surpassed $1 trillion in total payment volume (TPV) for the year, representing a 25% increase compared to 2022. This massive volume corresponds to approximately 1% of the global gross domestic product (GDP).

In terms of revenue, Stripe is estimated to have generated approximately $14 billion in gross revenue in 2023. Net revenue, which excludes the fees passed on to financial partners like Visa, Mastercard, and banks, is estimated to be around $3.5 billion to $4 billion. Despite the massive scale, Stripe's core business model continues to rely heavily on its standard pricing of 2.9% plus 30 cents per successful card charge, though enterprise clients negotiate custom rates.

Stripe's customer base exceeds millions of businesses worldwide, including more than 100 enterprise companies that each process over $1 billion annually with Stripe. Notable high-volume customers include Amazon, Ford, Salesforce, and OpenAI.
